// why this exists: Command 05B: the shared parser modules (_shared/parser/pdfExtract.ts, docxExtract.ts) import 'mammoth' and 'pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.mjs' as bare specifiers so the exact same .ts source compiles and runs under this repo's Node test harness (npm run test:parser, using node_modules) as well as here, under Deno. This import map is what makes the bare specifiers resolve under Deno — to the pinned npm packages, matching package.json exactly. Deno 2 (see supabase/config.toml's edge_runtime.deno_version) picks up a deno.json colocated with a function's entry point automatically.
